title: Redmi K100 Pro to use a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V SoC, design and key specs revealed
description: After revealing the design and key features of the Redmi K100 Pro Max recently, the company has now started to reveal more details about the Redmi K100 Pro. In a series of posts on Weibo, Redmi has confirmed that the K100 Pro will be powered by a new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V chipset, bearing the model number SM8850-1-AB. The company claims the handset scored 4.09 million points in the AnTuTu benchmark. It will also feature a dedicated graphics chip and a 3D circulating cold-pump cooling system. description: Back in June, we heard that Fire-Boltt would expand into the smartphone business in India, but we didn't have the specifics. Well, thanks to Indian online retailer Flipkart, we now know when Fire-Boltt will launch its first smartphone. Fire-Boltt, which currently sells smartwatches, earphones, and smart glasses, will launch its first smartphone under the Boltt branding in India on August 25. description: Google has released the first official teaser for the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, which is set to debut on August 12. While the video doesn't reveal much about the foldable, previous leaks have already detailed its design and key specs. The teaser video offers a brief look at the Pixel 11 Pro Fold's silhouette, along with a glimpse of its inner display. We can also see the rear camera module, which appears to retain the same design as the one found on the Pixel 10 Pro Fold. title: TCL Tab A1 Plus Nxtpaper is now available in the US
description: TCL unveiled the Tab A1 Plus and its Nxtpaper variant in early March at MWC, and now the Nxtpaper version is finally available in the US. You can grab it from TCL's online store for $299.99 for a limited time during the company’s Back to School sale, or from Amazon. The RRP is $399.99. title: Sony adds an interesting new color to its WH-1000XM6 range
description: Sony's successful flagship noise-cancelling headphones, the WH-1000XM6, are now available in a new color: Olive Gray. That's right, Olive Gray, not Olive Green as you might have expected. As you can see it has a very subtle shade of green - it's almost gray, but not quite. This is the sixth color option for the WH-1000XM6, joining black, Platinum Silver, Midnight Blue, Sand Pink, and Sandstone in the lineup. Obviously, the new color doesn't change the specs in any way, so you're getting the same top-tier noise cancellation enabled by the QN3 processor, up to 30 hours of battery life...

title: Google rolls out Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8 to Pixel devices
description: Google is rolling out the Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8. This update will be available to AOSP, as well as to Google Pixel devices, as part of Feature Drops. This update does not feature new user-facing changes, and is focused on critical bug fixes and system performance. One of the changes in this update is a fix for the loud audio distortion and static. The update addresses a persistent buffer management flaw within the audio framework, which resulted in random bursts of loud static and corrupted audio during media playback and system notifications. title: Google kills unreleased AI app
description: Google is rather notorious for killing apps and services left and right, even quite successful ones. This time, however, the company has gone further than it usually does and killed an app that was never released to begin with. It was called Google AI Studio and it was supposed to become available on both Android and iOS. The app was listed in the Google Play Store and the App Store as a pre-order, and about 800,000 people actually pre-ordered it, so clearly there was some interest for it out there. title: The European Commission puts AI transparency rules into practice
description: The European Commission will now enforce the AI transparency rules from the 2024 AI Act, slapping rule-breakers with hefty fines. In 2024, the European Commission outlined new guidelines and rules on the transparency of AI systems across the bloc. Under the new transparency requirements, companies, institutions, bodies, and agencies must label AI-generated or manipulated content clearly and visibly. The EU has created a set of icons for the occasion - "AI", "AI Generated", and "AI Modified". Labelling applies to images, audio, and video content that resemble existing persons, objects,...

title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra is in testing with two big sensors for its 10x zoom camera
description: According to a new leak from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, the Oppo Find X10 Ultra is currently being tested with two options for its second telephoto camera, the one with 10x optical zoom. The company will pick between two 50MP sensors, both the same 1/1.95" type size. One is Samsung's ISOCELL GNB, the other is OmniVision's OV51A. Both have telephoto macro capabilities too, so it's unclear what the exact differences are. description: Oppo's F33 and F33 Pro only came out this April, but now a new rumor from a tipster on X claims that the company is already working on the F35 family that will supposedly comprise these devices' successors. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro is official with a 6,000mAh battery, triple camera setup
description: The Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro has made its debut in India with a triple-rear camera setup, a 6,000mAh battery, and 6 years of guaranteed software support. Samsung had revealed all the key features of the handset last week and also confirmed its pricing. The phone will be available for purchase via Flipkart starting August 8 in Aurora Green and Alpha Black color options. As a launch offer, the phone will be sold at a starting price tag of INR 23,999 ($250) for the base 6GB/128GB variant. description: According to two separate sources, Samsung is considering dropping the dated 10MP 3x telephoto camera on the Galaxy S27 Ultra. One of the sources specifically states that there won't be a substitute for the 3x telephoto camera. Only the 200MP main unit, the 50MP 5x telephoto shooter and the 50MP ultrawide camera will remain.
